title: suite ledger full logs + informative tail; update-warning suppression; test-child isolation

migration.olderRows: existing and pre-v14 rows keep log_path NULL; no value is fabricated
migration.guard: SELECT name FROM pragma_table_info('suite_results') WHERE name = 'log_path'
migration.lineageDetection: detectSchemaLineage() reads PRAGMA table_info (never the colliding user_version alone); a DB with steps.preclaim_death_count and runs.matchlock_policy present but suite_results.log_path absent is pre-v14 and MUST run the guarded ALTER
migration.idempotencyCheck: forced slow-path re-run proves every guarded step is idempotent and adds no duplicate column

priority: lane verdict and per-lane tests/pass/fail counter lines (Serial lane: / Parallel lane:, the intermediate >>> ... lane: FAILED/PASSED form, and the current ℹ tests|pass|fail N and legacy # tests|pass|fail N forms)
the complete ✖ failing tests: block(s); when more than one lane produced a block the remaining budget is split fairly so no lane's failures vanish
as much of the final raw output as still fits under the cap
rules: the composed tail never exceeds capBytes
repeated lane markers/counters are deduped while lane order is preserved
output at or under the cap is returned unchanged (the caller keeps the raw output)
the shim stores the composed tail only when the output exceeds the cap; the full log is persisted separately at <state dir>/suite-logs/<row id>.log
no evidence is deleted: the full log path is reported with red evidence and in the replay banner when the row has one
tailComposer.publishSplit: the shim writes a unique <state dir>/suite-logs/.pending-<random>.log temp file and passes it as log_path; the control plane renames it to <row id>.log and stores the absolute path, or leaves log_path NULL with one bounded warning

shapes.name: serial-red-parallel-green
shapes.fixture: captured real two-lane log with the serial lane red and the parallel lane green
shapes.expectation: both lane verdicts plus the complete serial ✖ failing tests: block are retained; the parallel green summary/counters survive

shapes.name: both-red
shapes.fixture: captured real two-lane log with both lanes red
shapes.expectation: both lane verdicts and both ✖ failing tests: blocks are retained within the cap

shapes.name: green
shapes.fixture: captured real two-lane log with both lanes green
shapes.expectation: the lane summary lines survive and no ✖ failing tests: block is emitted; trailing raw output fills the remaining budget

boundaryChecks: Buffer.byteLength(result) <= capBytes for every over-cap fixture
a ✖ failing tests: block that alone approaches the cap is retained
a plain oversized output with no lane markers yields the last cap bytes

isolationGuard.violation: a tests/**/*.test.ts or e2e-tests/**/*.test.ts file that spawns a daemon or references the CLI entry without building the child env through cleanChildEnv (directly or through an imported helper that uses it)

allowlist.reason: pure static scanner; mentions bin/tamandua only as fixture/comment text and never spawns
